newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks jump 2,000-point mark at noon.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks jump 2,000-point mark at noon.

text.p: Pakistan stocks jumped across the 2,000-point mark at midday on Wednesday on heavy buying of blue chips inclduing Hub Power, telecom utility PTCL and ICI Pakistan, dealers said.
"There has been steady buying by local and foreign investors," dealer Mudassar Malik said. "Blue chip Hub Power and PTCL are leading the rally. Some second-tier stocks are also in demand."
The index rose 40.57 points, or 2.07 percent, to 2,004.78 at noon. Losers led gainers 94 to 57. PTCL rose 3.10 rupees to 42.20 and Hub Power 1.35 to 57.75. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
